review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview Would you like to help enrich the lives of learners around the world? RM India (RM Education Solutions India Private Limited) is the India Delivery Center for UK based RM Plc. A leading supplier of technology and resources to the education sector, RM India helps deliver great education products and services that help teachers to teach and learners to learn. Our mission is to achieve growth by improving life chances of people. At RM India, we are driven by the potential of our business to touch lives and shape the future. At RM, we’ve been pioneers of education technology since 1973. We provide technology and resources to the education sector, supporting over 20 million students and improving educational outcomes worldwide. What we do helps learners at all stages of their lives, from preschool to higher education and professional qualification; we partner with schools, examination boards, governments, and professional organisations globally to make learning more accessible, more engaging, and more impactful. RM operates through three divisions: Assessment (digital assessment and marking solutions), Technology (managed services, hardware, and software for schools), and TTS (educational resources). Visit us here to find out more: www.rmindia.co.in We encourage early applications as the vacancy may close once the position has been filled or final interviews have been arranged. Responsibilities Join Our Infrastructure Engineering Team as a Senior DevOps Engineer! Are you passionate about building scalable, reliable, and cutting-edge infrastructure solutions? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation and collaboration are key? If so, we want you to join our Infrastructure Engineering team as a Senior DevOps Engineer ! About The Role As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and tools that power our organization’s platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to enable seamless software delivery, optimize cloud environments, and ensure the reliability and scalability of our systems. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on our technology stack and drive the success of our strategic initiatives. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines to accelerate application and infrastructure delivery and improve deployment reliability. Deploying infrastructure and applications using existing deployment pipelines. Troubleshoot deployment failures. Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and monitoring to enhance operational efficiency. Collaborate with development and operations teams to ensure platform reliability, scalability, and performance. Lead incident management efforts, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement proactive solutions to minimize downtime. Mentor and guide junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation. Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies to drive continuous improvement in our platforms. Provide 4th line escalation for infrastructure issues including on call (on a rota basis). Produce technical documentation to a high standard. Experience 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineer, Deployment or related roles. Comprehensive knowledge of and implementation experience in Microsoft Azure ecosystem, which must include Azure Kubernetes, Application Gateway, and either PostgreSQL or SQL Server. Knowledge of APIM, ServiceBus and associated diagnostics services underpinning data processing and distributed applications is desirable. Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible and Helm Charts preferred) and CI/CD pipelines (ADO preferred). Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, etc.) and experience with monitoring/logging tools (Grafana, Azure Log Analytics, etc.). Deep understanding of networking, security, and system architecture best practices. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead incident response and root cause analysis. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a passion for mentoring and knowledge sharing. What's in it for you? At RM My Work Blend @ RM provides office-based colleagues with flexible and hybrid working options to suit them. As well as, you can spend a proportion of your time working with flexibility of hours, as appropriate to the role. We encourage you to discuss arrangements for this role with your potential line manager during the recruitment process. We expect how we make best use of hybrid working may continue to adapt as we adjust to our new ways of working. As well as a competitive salary our core benefits package includes Group Health Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life Insurance, Doctor consultation reimbursement, annually, Medical reimbursement, monthly/Qtry/Annual Rewards & Recognition program, Annual Salary Review & Bonus payouts, Children’s Education Assistance Subsidy, Summer Vacation Scheme, Staff Children Engagement Programme, Knowledge Acquisition Subsidy, Transportation Subsidy, Birthday & Marriage gifts and Subsidized Technopark Club Membership. RM India also has a comprehensive Rewards & recognition program to recognize and reward employees. You could even earn yourself an extra bonus for successfully recommending a friend or family member for a position within RM. To better reflect the society that we serve, we’re committed to building a diverse workforce and creating an inclusive and welcoming environment for all. To achieve this, we create teams of talented people from different backgrounds and experiences and strive to be a business where our people can bring their whole selves to work, we also want to make the recruitment process as inclusive as possible for everyone. Should you require additional support with your application or through the interview process, please contact us at recruitment@rm.com

You’ll conduct iGaming competitor research, investigate user journeys, organise product work and use AI coding tools to create prototypes, dashboards, automations and internal tools. This is an entry-level role, but we are specifically looking for someone who already builds things independently. You might have created a website, app, automation, data tool or another personal project using Claude Code, Codex, Lovable, Replit or similar tools. You do not need professional software-development experience. You do need to show us something you have built, explain how you approached it and demonstrate that you can use AI to solve problems rather than only generate answers. Roles & Responsibilities Work directly with the Head of Product on research, analysis and product operations. Research publicly available iGaming products, features and user experiences. Compare registration, onboarding, payments, promotions, loyalty and gameplay journeys. Document findings using screenshots, structured notes and comparison tables. Turn research into short, practical recommendations. Use AI coding tools to create prototypes and demonstrate ideas. Build small internal tools, dashboards, data collectors and workflow automations. Test websites, prototypes and internal tools across desktop and mobile. Investigate product questions using spreadsheets, analytics and available data. Prepare briefs and organise tasks for designers, developers and other teams. Review completed work against the original brief and document any problems. Organise research, meeting notes, decisions and follow-up actions. Monitor relevant developments across iGaming, payments, digital products and AI. Requirements A recent graduate or someone with up to two years of professional experience. Experience with vibe coding or AI-assisted development. At least one personal, university or experimental project you can show us that you built using AI coding tools. Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Codex, Lovable, Replit or similar tools. The ability to turn an idea into a basic working website, prototype, automation or internal tool. Curiosity about how digital products and businesses work. Strong attention to detail when testing websites and reviewing information. Clear written communication and an ability to summarise research concisely. Comfort using spreadsheets and organising structured information. The initiative to investigate a problem independently before asking for instructions. Good judgement about when AI-generated work is incomplete, inaccurate or poorly designed. An interest in iGaming, online products, payments, fintech or gaming. Based in Malta or willing to relocate. Useful, But Not Essential Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL or APIs. Experience with analytics, automation, scraping or data visualisation. Familiarity with iGaming products or online payments. Experience with ClickUp, Figma or other product-management tools. A degree in business, technology, economics, information systems, marketing or a related subject. Why Join Paradise Media Work directly with an experienced product leader. Get broad exposure to product, AI, research, analytics and iGaming. Use modern AI tools as a normal part of your work. Build prototypes and tools rather than only writing reports. Take on meaningful responsibility early in your career. Develop towards a Product Analyst, Product Manager or AI Product Operations role. Work from our Balluta Bay office, with panoramic sea views, a private gym, massage chairs and collaborative workspaces. Application Requirement Please include a link, screenshots or a short demonstration of something you built using AI coding tools. It can be a personal, university or experimental project. Tell us what you built, why you built it, which tools you used, what you personally contributed and what went wrong before you got it working.

Combining cutting-edge hardware and AI technologies, the company is working at the forefront of medical-device innovation. The Opportunity We are seeking a Senior Software Quality Engineer to play a key role in developing and maintaining quality standards across the product development lifecycle. Working closely with software, systems and hardware engineering teams, you will champion design quality assurance, ensure regulatory compliance and help establish robust quality processes as the company continues to grow. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role offering significant ownership and the opportunity to influence product quality, design controls and quality-system implementation within a fast-paced, early-stage environment. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring alignment with FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, IEC 62366-1 and other applicable medical-device standards. Partner with engineering teams to develop and maintain Design History Files (DHFs), including software requirements, architecture and design specifications, verification and validation documentation, risk-management files, cybersecurity documentation and traceability matrices. Lead and support risk-management activities, including Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), hazard analysis and risk assessments in accordance with ISO 14971. Oversee software verification and validation activities, ensuring appropriate testing, documentation and traceability throughout the product development lifecycle. Lead computerized system assurance and validation activities for software tools and systems used in product development and quality processes. Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional teams to support design development, supplier quality and design-transfer activities. Support internal and external audits, ensuring relevant documentation and objective evidence are available to demonstrate compliance. Contribute to root-cause investigations, nonconformance management, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and ongoing issue resolution. Support management reviews, quality-data analysis and continuous improvement initiatives. Promote a strong quality culture, working collaboratively with engineering and other stakeholders to integrate quality into product design and development. Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline. At least 8 years of experience in quality engineering or medical-device development, ideally spanning concept development through to production release. Proven experience working within a regulated medical-device environment. Strong knowledge of medical-device regulations and standards, including FDA requirements, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 and IEC 62366-1. Hands-on experience with software verification and validation (V&V), including test documentation, traceability and design controls. Practical experience with risk-management methodologies, including FMEA, hazard analysis and risk assessment. Experience supporting design assurance and maintaining design-control documentation throughout the product lifecycle. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, quality and external partner teams. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and develop practical solutions in a changing environment. A proactive, hands-on approach and the ability to thrive in an early-stage company. Desirable Experience Experience with AI/ML-enabled medical devices or software as a medical device (SaMD). Familiarity with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS). Experience with cybersecurity documentation and software-related risk management. Exposure to supplier quality, design transfer and product development in a hardware-and-software environment. Why Join? Work on innovative technology at the intersection of medical devices, software and brain-computer interfaces. Take ownership of quality engineering activities within a growing, technically advanced team. Collaborate directly with multidisciplinary engineering teams to shape product quality and regulatory readiness. Contribute to technology designed to make a meaningful difference in people's lives.
